mechanism: Add at most one previously unrecorded end-4 key after the original head positions and before end-1 in pc_f_record3. Existing chain depth, head tables, search/lazy/skip/fold rules and routes stay unchanged.
difference_from_old_work: R3 INS_MAX 2-to-6/8 densified the match head. This retains that head density and inserts only the terminal four-byte key wholly inside the matched span; the original end-1 key crosses the first mismatch except at the 258 cap. R22/R23 increased search depth without improving insertion coverage. This experiment changes candidate availability, not depth.

attribution.ownership: Inherited public PC matcher, original routing and original author headers retained.

proof_migration: No Rust function signature or explicit loop state changes. f_record3_spec must cover one extra slot_of_m/f_link call under j<lim and j<end. Original HeadBound, coherent ahead refresh and independent byte validators can be reused; exact extracted interface and fresh original gate remain required.
